edits.new: For each enumerated subject, identify broader subjects by comparing their `subject` headings alone. Imagine another post that fits the child heading: if it could fail to fit the proposed parent heading, use a broader parent. Use these relationships to build the hierarchy upward, combining shared headings. Retain every enumerated subject as an entry, including it in each branch that passes this check. Give every heading and subheading its own entry.
edits.old: For each enumerated subject, identify broader subjects by comparing their `subject` headings: every post about the child subject must also be about the parent. Use these relationships to build the hierarchy upward, combining shared headings. Retain every enumerated subject as an entry, including it in each branch where this relationship holds. Give every heading and subheading its own entry.
